about_the_game:
COMING SOON!
Find limited intentional bugs in the free DEMO!!

Your computers are the perfect habitat for these neat little bugs!

They're usually invisible, but with this proprietary console you can discover what's living in your personal computer!

Drag around the console on your desktop to see where they're hiding!

  • Name your species

  • Feed the bugs

  • Pet the bugs

  • ??? -it's a secret- 

Unlock more features of this device as you find more data and grow as a researcher

Not all computer bugs cause problems. These tiny critters just want to make you day a little better! :)

Some GPU's have issues rendering window transparency, reach out to us on the community forums or social media if you run into un-intentional bugs <3

short_description: Use this device to find the friendly bugs that live in your computer! Observe, interact, and identify these funny little creatures and share your discoveries with your friends! Become a bug researcher and name your new species!
